reviewedInvariants: New role requires a positive identified PR; PR1544 is globally denied at any head, including manual-only entries.
Exact candidate workflow path/blob must select a finite registered source and match the active catalog workflow ID/path. Unknown or changed source has no fallback.

Every same-source definition sharing a skipped display name must prove; their observed same-name jobs must each be completed/skipped and check-bound. Unknown names and null-proof source definitions remain gates.
Dependencies are recursively proved with cycle rejection and exact condition/needs identities; all authored inherited rules lead to direct reviewed roots.
Required source guards are uniquely found in the same run/attempt and joined to successful checks by GitHub app, suite, head, run, attempt, job/check URL, name, timestamps and conclusions.
Run association must be unique and match PR number/URL, exact head, head/base repository identity and URLs, and main base ref. No head/base substitution from current-main state.
Recorded run base must equal the comparison base and merge base with zero behind commits; ahead/identical counts must be internally consistent. Otherwise the source proof fails closed.

Every sweep independently reads complete run/catalog/job inventories, exact-head workflow directory and recorded-base ancestry. Canonical equality covers their identities, states, associations and source results.
Two sweeps, 64-request ceiling and existing time limits remain unchanged. All additional reads flow through the existing bounded read helper.
Native/manual workflow bytes, admission policy and existing deploy source-policy handling are untouched. Skip classification is not a native qualification or successful browser execution.
reviewCorrectionsResolved: The original second-sweep base-drift control rejected in its fixture URL assertion. The revised fixture deliberately serves valid ancestry for the alternate recorded base, then the test requires the collector's inventory-changed error and verifies two ancestry reads.
A focused ambiguous matrix-name control now supplies one success/failure sibling and confirms neither same-name check receives the new role.
Additional source-guard controls consistently mutate both check and job to failed, cancelled, skipped or in-progress, plus absent guard, and confirm the browser skip remains a gate.
remaining: Execute the 75-test controller suite and required hosted source gates on the exact published candidate.
Exercise the real bounded collection path under hosted validation; source review and fixture authorship do not establish runtime success.
Keep ordinary release evidence, original trace ordering and physical/native qualification requirements unchanged.
